channel.title: Art Ninja
channel.desc: Ricky is ready to reveal his latest diamond encrusted arty creation but is shocked to discover it has been stolen! Luckily detective Gav puts on his deerstalker and comes to the rescue whilst Ricky gains inspiration from artist Iris Scott and her finger print painting. But can the pals get to the bottom of the mystery of the missing diamonds.
